notes: Gold labels for the on-device eval. None of these appear in prompts.json few_shot — reusing the examples would measure memorisation, not classification. expected_min is null wherever no duration was spoken; a model that fills one in is wrong even if the number is plausible. ambiguous entries carry alternate_code: either counts as correct.
